# Complex Phenotyping at Scale with and without LLMs Using PhenotypeR

-   [**Program**](program.qmd) contains the schedule of the practical sessions.
-   [**Presentations**](Presentations/index.qmd) contains the presentations used during the training sessions.

## Set up

1)  R and RStudio

If you don't already have them, install R and RStudio. Open up RStudio where we'll do work.

2)  Install Ollama app

You'll need the Ollama app. If you don't already have it you can download and install using one of these links.

-   [macOS](https://ollama.com/download/Ollama-darwin.zip)

-    [Windows preview](https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe)

-    Linux: `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`.

-   [Docker image](https://hub.docker.com/r/ollama/ollama).

3)  Use the Ollama R package to get MedGemma:4b. You'll need 4Gb RAM free.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("ollamar")
library(ollamar)
test_connection() 
pull("MedGemma:4b")
list_models() # you should now see the MedGemma:4b model 
```

4)  Install R packages used throughout

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
library(ollamar)
pak::pkg_install("duckdb")
pak::pkg_install("OHDSI/PhenotypeR")
pak::pkg_install("ellmer")
pak::pkg_install("dbplyr")
pak::pkg_install("dplyr")
pak::pkg_install("gt")
pak::pkg_install("here")
pak::pkg_install("listviewer")
pak::pkg_install("rmarkdown")
pak::pkg_install("omopgenerics")
pak::pkg_install("omock")
pak::pkg_install("OmopConstructor")
pak::pkg_install("CodelistGenerator")
pak::pkg_install("CohortCharacteristics")
pak::pkg_install("CohortConstructor")
pak::pkg_install("visOmopResults")
```

5)  Download mock data

```{r, eval=FALSE}
omock::downloadMockDataset("synpuf-1k_5.4")
```
